question: According to the Census of India 2011, which state has the largest number of Muslim population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Uttar Pradesh has the largest Muslim population in India according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The state has approximately 38.4 million Muslims, making up about 19.3% of the total population of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Muslims in Uttar Pradesh are the largest minority community in the state.
 
• The districts with significant Muslim populations include Moradabad, Rampur, and Saharanpur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Demographics of Uttar Pradesh**

 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India.
 
• It is home to over 200 million people as of the 2011 census.
 
• The state has a diverse population with various religious and ethnic communities.
 
 
 
• **Muslim Population in India**
 
 
• Muslims are the largest minority community in India, constituting about 14.2% of the total population.
 
• Other states with significant Muslim populations include West Bengal, Bihar, and Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Religious Diversity in India**
 
 
• India is known for its religious diversity, with Hinduism, Islam, Christianity, Sikhism, Buddhism, and Jainism being the major religions.
 
• Religious tolerance and coexistence are significant aspects of Indian society.
 
 
 
• **Census Data Collection**
 
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.
 
• The census provides comprehensive demographic data that is essential for policy-making and planning.
